sources.title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models ...
sources.snippet: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a core technique in the post-training of large language models, yet its training dynamics remain poorly understood. This paper provides a systematic investigation of OPD dynamics and mechanisms.
